Directly addresses the drifter-expat context (Spain, move-home fund, thin transaction history over short window) and acknowledges the 'no target date' blocker specific to someone in transition; feels personalized, not templated.
Ends with a single, concrete next step (set target date) that unlocks the entire plan; CTA is clear and removes ambiguity about what unblocks progress.
